purpose: Ground boost pad concept exploration, not a finished 3D asset
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a polished 3D videogame prop concept exploration board for ground SPEED BOOST PADS in Biggas Hover Racing. This is a concept art sheet, not a screenshot or finished Blender model. Landscape high resolution board, neutral light grey background, clear readable composition, three evenly spaced columns labeled "01 · PLACA TURBO", "02 · BALDOSAS", "03 · BANDAS". Original designs inspired by retro arcade kart racing functional track boost arrows; no logos or existing branded assets.

Art direction: markedly low-poly chunky planar bevels, few large faces, visible low-resolution hand-painted pixel textures, cream painted steel, deep desaturated petrol blue, ochre yellow and burnt-orange accents, bright cyan energy. Subtle comic ink edges and restrained halftone shadows matching a paper/comic shaded hover racing game. No photorealism, smooth high-poly plastic, microdetail, generic glowing sci-fi grids or overly complex greebles. Flat road-flush devices, passable surfaces; no standing gates or jump ramps. Strong readable forward-pointing arrows, one consistent travel direction in each view, readable from a third-person chase camera at speed.

Design 01: a broad single rectangular chamfered steel pad, blue-grey recessed center, three HUGE ochre/cream forward chevrons, small inset cyan light strips along side rails, cream corner plates and a few orange corner clamps. Nearly flush shallow platform. This is the boldest simplest silhouette and the lead candidate.
Design 02: three interlocking shallow square tiles placed consecutively along travel direction, each with one chunky cyan forward chevron; petrol and cream frame, sparse ochre pixel wear. Consistent modular seams, same mechanic as 01.
Design 03: three thin transverse strips placed consecutively, each strip carrying a row of simple yellow directional chevrons and small blue light accents; painted cream/petrol shallow metallic edging. Same mechanic as 01, lightweight modular silhouette.

In EACH column show two aligned rows of the SAME prop in four views: top orthographic, front, left side, three-quarter perspective. Top row labeled "CON TEXTURA" uses colored pixel textures; second row labeled "SIN TEXTURA" uses plain neutral grey clay and simple visible geometric edges. Make the three-quarter view larger within each row and the top/front/side views compact but readable. Maintain exact proportions and details across textured and clay rows; painted arrows/wear disappear in clay, don't turn painted decals into geometry. Front and side must show low thin thickness, never a tall block.

Bottom of EACH column: one larger tasteful three-quarter in-context thumbnail showing that design embedded flush into a short section of ochre asphalt racetrack, under label "AL ACTIVARSE". Arrows brighten cyan/white and 3-5 short forward motion streaks skim close to the ground, a restrained glow, no large vertical beams or explosion. No vehicle needed. Keep arrows readable and floor texture uncluttered. Each thumbnail has same camera and scale for comparison. Small clean typography, generous spacing, consistent lighting. Header only "BOOSTS DE PISTA" and subtitle "Exploración low-poly · lectura rápida · activación". The emphasis is on beautiful practical props and strong silhouettes, not dense explanatory text.
refinement: Edit this concept sheet only in the THREE middle panels labeled SIN TEXTURA. Keep the complete rest of the board pixel-identical if possible: all top textured views, all labels, layout, colors, bottom activation examples. In the grey untextured middle panels, REMOVE ALL ARROW SHAPES, CHEVRON OUTLINES, arrow embossing and arrow engraving from ALL views (top and perspective). Those arrows are PAINTED TEXTURE / emissive masks, NOT modeled geometry. Replace them with perfectly plain flat grey central plates while preserving each pad's frame, border bevels, seams between modular tiles, corner clamps, physical edge light recesses, same silhouette and same grey lighting. Middle panel design 01 has a plain flat blank broad central plate, design 02 three plain flat blank square central plates, design 03 three plain flat blank narrow strips. Absolutely no arrows anywhere in the grey untextured row. This makes the sheet an accurate low-poly modeling reference. Do not alter any colored arrows in the textured top or activated bottom panels.
